public_history.clue: A common household pet that meows
A loyal animal that barks and wags its tail
A feathered creature that sings and can fly
A scaly creature that swims in rivers and lakes
Four-legged stable beast ridden in a saddle that neighs
Farm animal that gives milk and says moo
Big savanna cat with a mane that roars
Horned hoofed creature that bleats and climbs cliffs
Long-eared hopper that nibbles carrots and lettuce
Tiny rodent with a long tail that squeaks and nibbles cheese
Stubborn beast of burden with long ears that brays
Striped African wild equine with black and white stripes
Pink snorting livestock that wallows in mud and oinks
Shaggy Himalayan ox with a bushy tail that grazes high mountain grass
A green amphibian that hops and croaks in ponds
A tiny insect that buzzes and makes honey in hives
Sly reddish wild canid that raids henhouses at night
Grey wild pack hunter that howls at the full moon
Venomous hooded serpent of India and Africa that rises and spreads its neck
Six-legged crawler that lives in colonies and carries crumbs underground
Humped desert beast that stores water in its hump and crosses sand dunes
Antlered woodland grazer that bounds through forests
Web-footed waterfowl that honks and hisses at visitors
Young woolly sheep that wanders spring meadows and is raised for its meat
Nocturnal flutterer drawn to porch lights at night
South American pack animal with a woolly coat that spits at enemies
